channel.title: Daybrief
channel.description: AI first. Everything else that matters, twice a day.

item.title: unclebob/ub-mode
item.description: ub-mode is an agent skill that enforces disciplined software engineering principles when writing or changing code, with companion quality-gate tools.

item.title: obra/superpowers: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works
item.description: Superpowers is a software development methodology for coding agents, built from composable skills that make the agent ask what you're building, draft a spec for sign-off, then write an implementation plan. It supports many agent tools. Why it matters: A widely starred GitHub project, with 305,946 stars, offering a structured workflow for AI coding agents.

item.title: ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go: dsh-go — DeepSeek Harness 装进口袋：手机本机运行，也能遥控你的电脑。Android · Unofficial
togg53192-cmd/jailbreaks: LIST OF ALL MY JAILBREAKS
item.description: A GitHub repository of 31 jailbreak-style prompts targeting 25+ AI models, labeled as for research and educational use, with 4,930 stars.

item.title: HKUDS/DeepTutor: DeepTutor: Lifelong Personalized Tutoring. https://deeptutor.info/
item.description: DeepTutor is a Python project for lifelong personalized tutoring, with 44,963 GitHub stars, 1,587 of them added today.

item.title: Can AI Help Ray Kurzweil Cheat Death?
item.description: Ray Kurzweil, at 78, created an AI replica of himself called Rai, accessible through a browser or smartphone and responding to voice.

item.title: Protein pudding sold in S'pore potentially contains glass fragments, SFA issues recall
item.description: Singapore's Food Agency recalled Arla Protein Salted Caramel Flavour Pudding (200g) over potential glass fragments; buyers should not eat it.

item.title: How China ‘risk factors’ loom over Anthropic’s hotly anticipated IPO filing
item.description: Anthropic's IPO filing, released Monday, cites more than a dozen China-related risks, including open-weight models, US-China tensions and Taiwan.

item.title: Palmer Luckey’s Anduril is getting into laptops — and claims they’ll be American-made
item.description: Anduril and Qualcomm plan BlueChip laptops for early 2027, starting with a rugged military-focused prototype designed and assembled in the US.

item.title: Horizon3 Announces NodeZero Integration With Palo Alto Networks Cortex XSOAR
item.description: Horizon3 announced its NodeZero integration with Palo Alto Networks Cortex XSOAR, bringing high and critical findings into Cortex as actionable incidents.

item.title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Tuesday
item.description: Broadcom finalized $63 billion in financing for Anthropic's AI chip purchases, and Meta upsized its secondary stock sale to $25 billion.

item.title: Anthropic Versus Anthropic
item.description: A commentary calls Anthropic both admirable and frustrating: it takes bold stands and has a relatively strong safety culture, yet does disappointing things.

item.title: 10 car brands in S’pore register fewer than 1 car a month; 4 dominate Jan-Sept sales
item.description: BYD, Toyota, Tesla and Mercedes-Benz made up 52.8% of Singapore's new car registrations from January to September 2026.

item.title: Open3DLab accuses Roblox of downloading 145GB of 3D assets for AI training purposes
item.description: Open3DLab says a crawler attributed to Roblox downloaded 145.5GB of its data, which it assumes was for AI training, ignoring robots.txt and its terms.

item.title: Simplify User Access Management with SCIM on Rapid7 Command Platform
item.description: Rapid7 Command Platform now supports SCIM, letting customers automate user provisioning and deprovisioning through their identity provider.

item.title: WeRide launches global insurance partnership program to support L4 autonomous driving
item.description: WeRide launched a global insurance partnership program for L4 autonomous driving, with Allianz Insurance Singapore and Ping An Property & Casualty as first partners.

item.title: Sequoia and General Catalyst value ex-police chief’s AI startup at $400m — reports
item.description: London-based AI startup 22one, founded by a former senior police officer, reportedly reached a valuation of around $400m, backed by Sequoia and General Catalyst.

item.title: Apple Fixes Possibly Exploited CoreGraphics Flaw on Older iPhones
item.description: Apple's iOS 18.7.11 update fixes a CoreGraphics flaw that may have been exploited in targeted attacks, for older iPhones like the XS and XR.

item.title: Nuclear consultants, law firms appointed by EMA to prepare S’pore for 2027 mission by UN watchdog
item.description: Singapore's Energy Market Authority has appointed 12 firms, including Aecom Singapore, to help prepare for a 2027 IAEA review of its readiness for nuclear energy.

item.title: UI Boustead Reit posts maiden DPU of S$0.0371, a shade ahead of IPO forecast
item.description: UI Boustead Reit's first distribution, S$0.0371 per unit, beat its prospectus forecast by 0.8% despite net property income missing forecast by 1.8%.

item.title: Microsoft Authenticator Flaw Let Permissionless Android Apps Steal Work Account Tokens
item.description: Microsoft fixed an Authenticator for Android flaw that let a permissionless app pose as a trusted app and steal work account sign-in tokens.

item.title: Acts of God meet acts of AI in private equity’s new debt play
item.description: Private equity firms are adding force majeure-style clauses to new buyouts that could let companies stop the clock on defaults they attribute to AI disruption.

item.title: ASEAN envoy to visit Myanmar on Wednesday: Thai FM
item.description: BANGKOK: ASEAN's special envoy for Myanmar, Philippines Foreign Secretary Maria Theresa Lazaro, will visit Naypyidaw on Wednesday (Oct 28) and Thursday, her Thai counterpart said.

item.title: Zcash co-founder proposes ending grants subsidy, citing $125 million treasury
item.description: Zcash co-founder Sean Bowe proposed ending automatic grants funding, citing a treasury valuation of more than $125 million.

item.title: Unexplained DreamHost Incident Prompts Email, FTP Password Resets
item.description: DreamHost suspended File Manager and reset some email and FTP/SFTP passwords over the weekend, citing "an issue" with its systems.

item.title: An insecure neighbor: how a vulnerability chain led to an isolation bypass in cloud infrastructure
item.description: A Kaspersky researcher describes how a chain of vulnerabilities in Kubernetes, Konnectivity and the overlay network led to an isolation bypass in a major cloud provider, enabling remote code execution and compromise of other tenants' services. Why it matters: Shows cloud tenants can be exposed by flaws inside the provider's own infrastructure, a concern for security followers.

item.title: NASA plans to launch three massive rockets for the Artemis 3 crewed lunar test mission
item.description: NASA's detailed Artemis 3 plan has three spacecraft launching on heavy-lift rockets from Florida within two weeks, with no date yet.

item.title: Acer's Predator Atlas 8 gaming handheld finally launches at Best Buy on November 1 for $1,300
item.description: Acer's Predator Atlas 8 handheld goes on sale at US Best Buy on November 1 for $1,300, in a single Intel Arc G3 Extreme model.

item.title: iOS, macOS 27.2 Patch 286 Bugs; Fix for Exploited Flaw Backported to iOS 18
item.description: Apple patched 286 vulnerabilities in iOS and macOS 27.2 and backported a fix for an exploited CoreGraphics zero-day to iOS 18.

item.title: Thailand’s September car production drops 6.08% on year
item.description: Thailand's car production fell 6.08% year on year in September to 120,319 units, while car exports rose 4.55%.

item.title: Siemens and NVIDIA Want to Train Inspection Before the First Build. Could 3D Printing Benefit?
item.description: Siemens and NVIDIA announced a system that lets electronics makers plan circuit-board optical inspection in a virtual 3D model before the first board is built.

item.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds below $80,000 as AI buildout draws investor attention and capital
item.description: Galaxy Digital beat third-quarter earnings estimates, with $419 million in treasury and corporate profit, and announced a fresh $200 million buyback.

item.title: PayPal reports Q3 revenue up 2% YoY to $8.58B, below $8.71B est., TPV up 6% to $487.14B, and raises full-year adjusted EPS guidance to ~$5.60, above $5.39 est.
item.description: PayPal's Q3 revenue rose 2% year on year to $8.58 billion, below estimates, while it raised full-year adjusted EPS guidance to about $5.60.

item.title: AI-Generated Fake Login Pages Are Making Account Takeovers Easier
item.description: Generative AI makes fake login pages easier to build and more convincing, and some can capture MFA codes or hijack sessions.

item.title: Memory stocks lost their shine despite strong earnings
item.description: Sandisk, Micron, Seagate and Western Digital are in the S&P 500's bottom 10% this half despite blowout earnings, as investors question AI spending's durability.

item.title: Glasser now lets AI agents buy premium data per API call
item.description: Glasser lets AI agents pay per call for premium data from more than 2,000 endpoints across 80+ providers, with prices shown before each call.

item.title: Anthropic uses its IPO letter to renew its pledge that Claude will never show ads
item.description: In a cover letter to its IPO filing, Anthropic reaffirmed that it will never show ads in Claude conversations, arguing Claude's only goal should be providing helpful answers. Why it matters: Anthropic is forgoing a potential revenue stream that funds much of the internet, a notable stance as it goes public.

item.title: ASEAN could take years to be ready for next major energy disruption: Philippine energy secretary
item.description: Philippine Energy Secretary Sharon Garin says Southeast Asia could take years to prepare for another major energy disruption.

item.title: REDAXO core from 5.3.0 before 5.21.4 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the structure/history…
item.description: CVE-2026-117532 (CVSS 9.3) is an authentication bypass in REDAXO core 5.3.0 to before 5.21.4 that lets unauthenticated attackers forge login tokens.

item.title: Crypto wallet maker Keystone to destroy almost 19,000 devices after security breach
item.description: Keystone will destroy 18,835 unsold hardware wallets and suspend shipments after a website breach exposed 25,964 buyer records.

item.title: OCBC is Asia-Pacific’s strongest bank and third globally: The Asian Banker
item.description: OCBC ranked third globally and strongest in Singapore and Asia-Pacific in the TAB 2026 bank ranking; DBS placed 23rd and UOB 187th.

item.title: Hyphenate, which develops reinforcement-learning-driven AI agents to automate corporate finance tasks, raised a $45M Series A, taking its total funding to $54M
item.description: Hyphenate, which builds reinforcement-learning-driven AI agents to automate corporate finance tasks, raised a $45M Series A led by Nexus Venture Partners, bringing total funding to $54M. Why it matters: A new funding round for an AI agent startup automating finance work, relevant to agent and startup watchers.

item.title: AI promised less work. I've never worked more
item.description: A full-stack engineer says AI agents have made their workload heavier, not lighter, because they now juggle many parallel tasks that each need intermittent attention.

item.title: Fed expected to hold rates steady, but Warsh may point way to more hikes
item.description: Markets expect the Fed to hold rates steady this week after September's quarter-point increase, while investors watch Chairman Kevin Warsh for signals on future moves.

item.title: ST Engineering bags $5.6 billion in new contracts for Q3 2026
item.description: ST Engineering reported S$5.6 billion in new contracts in Q3 2026, bringing its nine-month total to S$13.2 billion.

item.title: Hiding Capabilities in AI Models
item.description: The paper shows AI models can hide encrypted capabilities that are provably hard to elicit or interpret, limiting the reliability of capability audits.

item.title: US deep tech VC Playground Global deepens Taiwan AI ties
item.description: Playground Global is deepening its Taiwan AI ties as portfolio companies announce products, funding and local operations tied to AI hardware and chip supply chains.

item.title: Crunchbase Data Shows Q3 Robotics Startup Funding Jumps 185% As US And China Lead Physical AI Push
item.description: Global robotics startup funding hit $9.9 billion in Q3, more than double Q3 2025, with China and the US leading 2026 investment.

item.title: Your AI Agents Need A Chief Operating Officer, Too
item.description: Rick Folgmann, COO of Get Covered, argues AI agents should be treated like accountable employees, with written rules and a named human manager.

item.title: Anthropic's IPO is risky business
item.description: Anthropic's IPO prospectus, over 90 pages, lists corporate risks that go beyond boilerplate, including potential catastrophic risks from its models and its current clash with the Trump administration. Why it matters: Shows how a leading AI lab describes its safety and business risks to investors.

item.title: AI Agents Are Media’s New Favorite Audience
item.description: Some publishers are producing content for AI agents rather than human readers, such as feeds optimized for AI.

item.title: Anthropic's S-1 excludes Labs co-lead Ben Mann from its "Continuing Founders" and Founder LLC; Anthropic says "it's still fair to refer to him as a co-founder"
item.description: Anthropic's S-1 excludes co-founder Ben Mann from its Continuing Founders group, though the company says he is still a co-founder.

item.title: Seatrium, Karpowership to develop floating power, digital infrastructure solutions in Singapore
item.description: Goh Ruoxue AI generated SINGAPORE – Mainboard-listed offshore and marine player Seatrium announced on Oct 27 a collaboration with global energy company Karpowership to develop floating power and infrastructure solutions…

item.title: SpaceX closes $40 billion debt financing for GPUs expected in the first half of 2027, Musk says
item.description: Elon Musk says SpaceX has closed $40 billion in debt financing for GPUs expected to arrive in the first half of 2027.

item.title: Nvidia to invest $3b in Meta as AI partnership expands
item.description: Nvidia plans to invest $3 billion in Meta as the two companies expand their AI partnership to optimize Muse models and agent infrastructure.

item.title: Bloom bot hackers loot $953K faster than you can microwave popcorn
item.description: Hackers drained $953,000 from 48 wallets linked to Telegram trading bot Bloom in 94 seconds; Bloom will reimburse nine traders.

item.title: There are now 5 inference providers for abliterated DeepSeek
item.description: A fast reasoning model, abliterated DeepSeek, is served by several independent providers through AllModels, which routes text and image requests to suitable ones.

item.title: How the Claude Code team does code review
item.description: Claude Code's team moved most code review to machines and risk-scaled human approval; merged PRs more than doubled while reverts fell over 40%.

item.title: OBB-PBD: Extending Parallel Box Decoding to Oriented Bounding Boxes for Referring Expression Grounding in Aerial Imagery
item.description: Extends a parallel box-decoding method to oriented boxes for grounding text-described objects in aerial images, lifting rotated IoU from 0.1253 (zero-shot baseline) to 0.303.

item.title: yaojingang/GEOInflow: Self-hosted web and AI crawler analytics for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). Track visitors, AI search…
item.description: GEOInflow is a self-hosted analytics tool that tracks website visitors, AI search referrals, and AI crawler activity for Generative Engine Optimization. It is MIT licensed and jointly published by 猎看科技 and 北京日报社智源GEO. Why it matters: Helps site owners see which AI crawlers visit their pages and how AI search contributes visitors and conversions.
